text:
Nina H: Quick flag — QA noticed big negative 'cache savings' on the per-tenant cost card after a canary rollback last night.
Omar V: saw that. root cause seems to be credits being recorded against the origin pool_id, while routing sticky sessions moved to fallback pools. agg misses align.
Sam T: Proposed quick fix: add an "attribution_preview" mode to the API that runs fingerprint-split attribution only for UI previews. non-billing.
Jen L: UX needs: badge "estimated" + hover explaining method and sample rate. also show delta vs pool-only so customers see the change.
Nina H: Can we implement matview per-minute to avoid rejoining huge tables on the fly?
Omar V: yes — matview shards by fingerprint % 128; will keep 1m granularity. cheap to update with our existing ingestion.
Sam T: API param: GET /costs?mode=attribution_preview&window=300. Server should emit telemetry: cost.preview.mode + sample_rate.
TelemetryBot: note: add histogram cost.preview.delta to compare preview vs pool-only across tenants.
Jen L: Action items: Omar builds matview + perf numbers; Sam wires param and telemetry; I'll add badge copy and delta sparkline.
Nina H: thanks — let's gate preview to ops & tenant admins for now.
